caption: The drawing depicts a doll-like figure with a round, beige face that has a flat expression, blue eyes, red lips, and faintly seen nostrils. The hair is depicted with short, black strokes and is covered with a frilled black bonnet tied under the chin with a raw black ribbon. The figure wears a long-sleeved, blue dress with puffed sleeves and a high, ruffled neckline. Over the dress, there is a white apron with black swirling line decorations fastened at the waist. The lower part of the dress consists of two blue gingham checkered layers with ruffled edges. Beneath the apron and dress, a red skirt with white floral or paisley motifs is visible. The figure has tan arms and hands, and feet covered with light brown footwear. The background is plain and unadorned. The artist's signature “Eugene Croe” appears in blue in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Aggie"
